data.raw_text:
Behind every disaster statistic is a human story.  2025 showed us climate change isn't about numbers, it's about families destroyed.   

Hurricane Melissa left nurse Maria walking 12 miles to work daily with no traffic lights.  8 years old Anna in Philippines missed 47 school days to typhoons. 
Greek farmer Dimitris watched his grandfather's 40 year olive groves burn: "Nothing left to pass to my son." 
Texas floods killed Sarah's family in 30 minutes: "I should have told them to run." European heat killed 2,305 grandparents alone in their homes. Climate change is a human rights crisis.  

What story from your community's weather disasters shows how extreme weather touches real lives? Share one memory that makes the human cost visible. 🌳
